subject.title: Feature: Per-call cost tracking & auth profile attribution

question: What OpenClaw surface should own resolved auth-profile attribution for completed model calls?
rationale: The source shows multiple adjacent usage/status/plugin paths, but choosing what metadata is persisted and exposed affects privacy, security, gateway contracts, plugin APIs, and UI behavior.

options.title: Canonical completed-call contract
options.body: Record a safe resolved authProfileId with completed model-call usage and aggregate all native views from that canonical accounting event.

options.title: Plugin-only usage seam
options.body: Keep core usage views unchanged and expose only a provider/plugin-owned accounting hook for optional ClawHub tooling.

options.title: Status-only hint
options.body: Show current or fallback profile hints in status without durable per-call attribution or per-profile aggregation.

recommendation.title: Canonical completed-call contract
recommendation.body: Record a safe resolved authProfileId with completed model-call usage and aggregate all native views from that canonical accounting event.

likelyOwner.reason: Current blame and prior review history both point to steipete around the central usage and status aggregation paths.
